scope: 162 corrective Astra ratings only; no historical or original-judge ratings pooled.

method.within_cell: Average all three observed run scores for each task/model/condition.
method.contrast: Subtract naive three-run mean from PEIL three-run mean within the same task/model. L-U separate secondary.
method.weighting: Equal weight six tasks within each fixed model. Across-model summary descriptive, three models equal weight.
method.uncertainty: 10,000 whole-task resamples, seed20261018; central95% task-composition sensitivity, not populationCI or significance. Leave-one-task-out ranges.
method.zero_width: Resampling tied observed task means yields [0,0]; no claim of equivalence, reliable judge accuracy or absence of latent uncertainty.
method.run_dependence: Run index replicate label, not shared seed. Three repeats do not increase independent task count beyond six.
method.conditioned_on: Observed three-run means and one valid Astra judgment per response; not repeated-judge reliability.
method.ordinal: Means of anchored ordinal ratings; frequencies, medians, ranges and W/T/L supplied.
method.by_task: Observed three-run triples and fixed-model ranges, not population intervals from n=3.
method.no_tests: All24primarymodel/contrast/metricmeans reported; no p-values, equivalence or universal-superiority claims.
